subject: Proposed team transition & manager reassignments — draft for review
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Clara Ramos <clara@peoplefirst.co>
Date: 2026-07-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Proposed team transition & manager reassignments — draft for review

Hi all,

Attached is a draft proposal for the engineering org transition we discussed last quarter. High level:

- Move the Inference Serving team under Platform (reports shift from Marcus -> Laura) to centralize runtime development.
- Split the FinOps/Optimization scope into a small cross-functional squad (lead by a senior PM) and a dedicated Quantization & Ops team (reports to Marcus temporarily).
- Reassign two managers (Eliza and Ken) to different dotted-line responsibilities; see attached org_chart_v2.pdf for the visual.

Key asks:
1) Feedback on manager assignments and whether the dotted-line approach is viable for operations coverage.
2) Any open headcount constraints that would block a July start.
3) For Monica/Clara: preferred cadence and required paperwork for manager-level moves and potential role-scoped performance reviews.

Attachments: org_chart_v2.pdf, transition_risks.xlsx, manager_brief.docx

This is sensitive — please do not forward outside the thread. If you have edits, reply-all with inline comments.

Thanks,

Tessa Morgan
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Ramos <clara@peoplefirst.co>
Date: 2026-07-01T11:08:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed team transition & manager reassignments — draft for review

Thanks for the draft, Tessa — good work putting this together. A few quick notes inline: 

On Tue, Jul 1, 2026 at 09:12 AM Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> - Move the Inference Serving team under Platform (reports shift from Marcus -> Laura) to centralize runtime development.

I support centralizing runtime work under Platform, but we should ensure the customer-facing SLA ownership stays with the product managers for the next three months while we transition. Can we add a 90-day service-level handoff plan to the manager_brief.docx?

> - Split the FinOps/Optimization scope into a small cross-functional squad (lead by a senior PM) and a dedicated Quantization & Ops team (reports to Marcus temporarily).

Agree with the split. Request: identify the PM candidate (internal vs hire) before we publically reassign reports — otherwise PM ramp will be the bottleneck.

Questions for Monica/Clara: what impact will these manager reassignments have on upcoming performance calibrations? We have mid-July calibration meetings and need to avoid surprises for managers being evaluated under different scopes.

Happy to hop on a 30-min sync after you incorporate these changes.

Laura Bennett
Director, Product
Redwood Inference
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Clara Ramos <clara@peoplefirst.co>
Date: 2026-07-01T14:30:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed team transition & manager reassignments — draft for review

Tessa / team — I appreciate the goals here. A couple of practical concerns from ENG ops perspective:

1) Key IC coverage: two senior ICs (A. Romero, S. Patel) are the main owners of the current deployment automation. If Eliza moves, we need formal knowledge transfer weeks before the manager move. I attached a short risks sheet in transition_risks.xlsx but we should also list KT owners in the brief.

2) Hiring & capacity: we have one open backend IC req in ether pooling (headcount committed). If we repurpose it for Quantization, that will delay other roadmap items. Please confirm whether the hiring freeze applies.

3) Timeline: I propose a staggered approach: announce manager reassignments to managers (private) week of 7/6, then team-level comms week of 7/13, with individual 1:1s for affected ICs scheduled immediately. That gives us two weeks for KT and calibration prep.

Lastly, for performance reviews: if a manager's scope changes before end-of-cycle reviews, the manager should recuse themselves from new-scope ratings and we should ensure the reviewer map in HR reflects the temporary reporting changes. Monica — can you confirm the reviewer mapping process?

-Marcus
Engineering Manager
Redwood Inference
From: Clara Ramos <clara@peoplefirst.co>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-07-02T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed team transition & manager reassignments — draft for review

Thanks for the context. Quick HR checklist for manager-level reassignment and sensitive comms: 

- Private notification to affected managers + 1:1 with People Ops (Monica) before any team announcement.
- Updated job profiles and role-scoped 90-day success metrics (manager_brief.docx should include these).
- Calibration rules: managers who change reporting lines within the review window should have their review anchored to the prior scope; new-scope ratings are documented by the receiving manager but not applied until after the 90-day handoff.
- Documentation: maintain a signed acknowledgement for each manager (DocuSign link) and upload the role-change memo to the employee file.

Link to suggested template: https://templates.peoplefirst.co/role-change-memo

I can run the private notifications and prepare the DocuSign packet; Monica, can you confirm if you need an LOE from me to support the week-of-7/6 notifications?

Best,
Clara Ramos
PeopleFirst Consulting
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Clara Ramos <clara@peoplefirst.co>
Date: 2026-07-02T16:44:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed team transition & manager reassignments — draft for review

Thanks everyone — clear actionable path. Summary / decisions: 

- Move forward with the centralization under Platform with the 90-day SLA handoff (Laura to draft SLA handoff doc).
- Manager private notifications: week of 7/6 (Clara + Monica to run); Tessa to attend Eliza's 1:1.
- Staggered comms: manager-level private -> individual 1:1s -> team announcement (7/13).
- Performance calibration: managers changing scope will have reviews anchored to prior scope; Monica to update reviewer mapping and HR will add notices to calibration packets.
- Action owners: Laura (SLA handoff doc + PM candidate confirmation), Marcus (KT plan + updated risks sheet), Monica (reviewer mapping + DocuSign logistics), Clara (DocuSign template & private notif LOE).

I'll schedule a 30-min sync tomorrow to finalize the timeline and approve public-facing comms. Please review attachments and the Drive doc before the call.

Tessa Morgan
VP, Engineering
Redwood Inference
